actions.action: Lift plant out of decorative pot and check roots
Trim off brown, mushy, or smelly roots if present
Repot into container with drainage holes using cactus/succulent mix with perlite or grit
Water only when soil is dry several centimeters down or pot feels light, then water thoroughly and drain
Move plant to sunniest spot, acclimating gradually over a week
Use a grow light 12-14 hours a day if sunny spot not possible
Prune yellow, brown, dead stems and leaves and cut back leggy stems

reason: The answer diagnoses overwatering when the plant was actually dehydrated, and its advice to water less would likely make the dehydration worse and delay the fix.
